Rules for arrival checks
Everyone on the desk should know how the desk handles it

Rules for arrival checks

This section explains how the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways should handle arrival checks with a steady, respectful approach. The goal is to keep the process calm for travelers, clear for staff, and safe for the animal.

When a traveler reaches the desk, greet them in a warm professional tone and keep the exchange simple. Ask only for the papers and items the process calls for, then review them carefully before moving ahead. <<FACT F086>> If anything is missing, unclear, or does not match the booking, stay polite and pause the check until the issue is sorted. Do not guess, waive a step, or make side promises to hurry the matter along.

The desk should also watch for arrival concerns that need extra care. If the traveler seems stressed, give brief reassurance and avoid crowding the counter. If the animal is restless, keep voices low and give the traveler space to settle things. The cabin team will monitor animals during flight, so our job is to make sure the handoff is clean and the records are right. <<FACT F092>> If the traveler arrives late for the process, follow the standard response without debate and refer the case when needed.

If there is a conflict between what the traveler says and what the file shows, be careful and factual. Do not fill gaps with assumptions. Use the approved record, note the issue in the desk log, and pass it to the senior coordinator if the situation is not routine. When the traveler needs direction, explain the next step in plain language and keep the tone friendly without becoming casual in a sloppy way.

Please contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor if anything about the arrival check is unclear or unusual.
